# Smart City and Sustainable Development Academy (SCSDA)

> Bilingual site of the Smart City and Sustainable Development Academy (SCSDA), a non-profit research and development institute in Chongqing, China, established with KU Leuven support. Work covers smart city systems, sustainable construction, digital delivery and applied research translation with industry.

The site is published in Chinese at the root and in English under /en/.

## Identifiers and profiles

- [Founding Dean](https://daguanghan.com/)

- [In the Media](https://scsda.cn/press/): Third-party media and government-portal coverage of SCSDA
- [Join Us](https://scsda.cn/join/): Opportunities and expressions of interest for researchers, students, visiting scholars, and partners interested in SCSDA
